amy-sales: Quick heads-up — ACME wants BYO HSM for the POC. Requirements they listed: FIPS+CC cert, vendor = SafeNet, 6-hour rotation cadence (ephemeral keys), 7yr audit log retention, proof-of-deletion, and split-custody for high-value keys. Can we support this for a short POC? Need throughput impact + rough pricing delta.

dan-crypto: We can support BYO via our key-proxy pattern. Need network egress + mTLS to their HSM. 6-hr rotation is technically OK but expect cache invalidation on every rotation. Rough perf impact: expect 10-25% p95 latency bump unless we do prefix-KV warmup. Also need their attestation artifacts (firmware + cert chain).

maria-solutions: For presales: ask ACME for expected QPS, avg seq len, concurrency, and whether rotations must be atomic across regions. Also confirm whether they truly need 6-hr or if 24-hr acceptable. For the POC we can propose a 6-hr stress test but recommend 24-hr in prod.

amy-sales: ACME responded with numbers: 200 req/s gen, avg 128 tokens, concurrency burst to ~1200. They also want a dry-run rotation test during the POC. Legal asked about key escrow and deletion proof — tagging @legal.

legal: Redwood policy: we do not escrow customer keys by default. For BYO we can provide signed deletion manifests and HSM attestation logs as evidence. Escrow only via explicit SOW + enterprise contract. We can provide an auditable deletion flow: manifest (SHA256) + timestamped auditor signature.

eng-runtime: Note from runtime side: frequent rotations cause KV/attn cache misses which increase token generation latency and CPU on the hosts. For their numbers (200 qps, 128 tokens) estimate ~12-18% throughput drop during steady-state if we don't pre-warm caches. We should offer a small warmup daemon that rehydrates caches post-rotate.

maria-solutions: Action items: 1) Ask ACME to whitelist our proxy IPs and open port 443; 2) Request HSM attestation bundle and FIPS/CC cert scans; 3) Agree on rotation acceptance criteria for the POC (we recommend three successful rotations under load). I'll draft the checklist.

amy-sales: I'll send a SOW addendum: one-time BYO integration fee $25k, plus throughput surcharge $0.015/token equivalent for proxied ops (estimate). Will circle back with exact numbers after Dan's runbook.

dan-crypto: I'll produce a short runbook + test vectors by EOD tomorrow. Sample test curl for POC rotation hook: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/internal/keys/proxy/rotate -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" -d '{"key_id":"acme-main"}'`

ops-oncall-bot: deploy-bot: Notice — key-proxy v1.2 rollout scheduled Tue 03:00 UTC. Expected maintenance window 15m. :information_source:

maria-solutions: I'll also prepare a minimal acceptance test (k6 script + synthetic tokens) to validate no >20% latency regressed post-rotate. Anyone object to that threshold?

eng-runtime: +1 from runtime. Also recommend we add a transient cache TTL of 90s to smooth bursts right after rotate.

amy-sales: Perfect. I'll send the checklist and intro email to ACME with these asks. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
